title: 네 이름 별
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Synth-pop. A bright, clean electric guitar plays a rhythmic, syncopated riff in the intro. A high-energy female vocal lead features a clear, polished tone with light reverb. The bassline consists of a punchy synth bass that follows a disco-influenced groove. Drums feature a crisp snare and a steady kick. Shimmering synth pads and occasional electronic sweeps provide harmonic texture. The track is in the key of E Major with a tempo of 120 BPM in 4/4 time.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[syncopated clean electric guitar riff]
(Ooh-ooh-ooh)

[Verse 1]
[female vocals]
옥상에 올라와서 [synth bass enters]
바람이 시원하네
별이 쏟아져
캔 하나 땄어
별자리 앱 켜봐
저게 뭔지 알아

[Pre-Chorus]
가장 밝은 거 저기 보여
이름이 없대

[Chorus]
[full drums and synth pads enter]
저 별에 네 이름 붙일래
오늘부터 네 거야
밤마다 올릴게
